items.text: Saquon Barkley ACTIVE for MNF vs DAL; postgame said hamstring 'came out great' and back issue unlikely to sideline him.
items.why: ETR expected; official active + player comments on hamstring/back.
items.implication: Maintains RB1 role; no reverse of any prior handcuff elevation.

items.text: ETR listed Puka Nacua as GTD/OPTIMISM pregame; Schefter confirmed he was officially ACTIVE vs Raiders.
items.why: Weekend injury summary optimism path confirmed by official active report.
items.implication: Full or near-full WR1 usage expected; no major beneficiary shift in LAR WR room.

items.text: ETR had Breece Hall as GTD/PESSIMISM; confirmed INACTIVE for Week 7 vs MIA (quad), missing another game.
items.why: Limited practice, Rapoport unlikely path realized in inactives.
items.implication: Continued absence elevates backup RB workload; monitor Week 8 ramp.

items.text: Jonah Coleman LOVE/upgrade: first game back led Broncos backfield in snaps (50%), rush share (41%), routes (34%); Dobbins only 21% snaps, Harvey fluky TD.
items.why: Clear snap/rush/route lead on return; prior season prediction validated.
items.implication: Coleman primary Broncos RB; Dobbins/Harvey reduced roles.

items.text: Cam Skattebo actually hurt (hamstring) but uncertain severity; on ETR Sunday watching list with Tracy.
items.why: Levitan assessment post-game; ETR listed hamstring.
items.implication: Monitor for next practice; potential NYG backfield shift if misses time.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs almost certainly fine after ankle turned on purposeful slide; would have been tilting if actually injured avoiding TD.
items.why: Purposeful slide; low concern from Levitan/ETR watch list.
items.implication: No major role change or handcuff elevation expected short-term.

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT in ETR weekend summary (high ankle sprain context from reports).
items.why: Missed prior games; confirmed out again.
items.implication: Ravens offense downgrade; backups/streamers elevated short-term.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks OUT per ETR; creates PHI WR opportunity vacuum for MNF.
items.why: Missed practices; confirmed out for MNF.
items.implication: Elevated targets/routes for remaining PHI pass-catchers; Berry noted slot opportunity (Lemon).

items.text: Josh Jacobs listed IN (active/return) in ETR weekend summary.
items.implication: Resumes lead RB role; Berry discussing ROS value expectations.

items.text: Matthew Berry calls to put respect on Tee Higgins' name (strong performance context).
items.implication: WR2/flex reliability in CIN offense with Chase.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty epitome of high-value-touch thesis: worst runner metrics (last in YPC 3.1, poor EPA/RYOE) yet fantasy RB13 PPR ppg via 9 inside-5 carries + league-leading 45 RB targets.
items.implication: Sustainable fantasy floor via opportunity despite poor efficiency; hold/start as RB2.
items.conflict: Efficiency data poor vs fantasy output

items.text: Tony Pollard exploded Sunday; Berry advises turning big game into sell-high opportunity if possible.
items.why: Outlier explosion; sustainable role/usage concerns implied.
items.implication: Trade while value peaked; not long-term RB1 lock.
items.conflict: Big game vs prior usage baseline

items.text: Texans WR routes on 29 Stroud dropbacks: Nico Collins 24 (clear lead), Tank Dell only 6 in first game back since 2024 (limited), Noel 15 (left early turf toe).
items.implication: Nico remains alpha; Dell limited reintegration caps immediate upside.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets for Nico; monitor Dell ramp

items.text: Xavier Worthy 33 routes (lead) on 36 Mahomes dropbacks in second game without Rashee Rice; has never topped 83 receiving yards in 37 career games.
items.why: Volume without Rice but historical ceiling constraint.
items.implication: Solid volume play but capped upside; not pure WR1 replacement.
items.conflict: High routes vs career yardage ceiling
